answer: Farming becomes an ocean bet on surviving 71 epochs of grading, and every yarrow settlement recomputes the willow schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 71 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 7 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 21 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
